Avoiding Instant Gratification & Wall Street Folly

thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on companies with a 'great ultimate destination' and 'long shelf life,' citing Costco and Amazon as prime examples. It warns against the 'sin and folly' of Wall Street and instant gratification, using the 'inner scorecard' and 'psychological glitches' as frameworks to avoid the illusion that more possessions will make one happier.
